envelope.description: Orchestrator failure route, plan sources and nested handling

body.title: Orchestrator failure route, plan sources and nested handling
body.summary: Copy the kept task failure data to RunFailure.data in the orchestrator, make collectPlanSources read a failed planner task's kept child result and each aggregate's handling, and have concludeRun merge nested handling.
acceptanceChecks: through the orchestrator the failure data of a failed aggregate, including partFailures and upstream, is present in RunFailure.data
a failed nested aggregate under a succeeding root makes the run incomplete and names it
a nested plan's handling is merged with prefix-qualified part ids in the final report
the broad docs run check is repeated here through the orchestrator so a regression fails early

tests.name: aggregate-failure.test.ts: failure data including partFailures and upstream reaches RunFailure.data under 'executor-aggregator-failed' through the orchestrator
nested-aggregate-failure.test.ts: a failed nested aggregate under a succeeding root makes the run incomplete and names it, with no run failure raised
run-handling-report.test.ts: root and nested aggregates with uncovered parts make the run incomplete, handling merged and the head shows the handling line
docs-aggregate-run.test.ts: the broad docs run completes through the orchestrator with a final report
